# one JSON line: the output of the Slurm client commands, as seen from a compute node
function esc(s)
    s = replace(s, "\\" => "\\\\", "\"" => "\\\"", "\n" => "\\n", "\r" => "", "\t" => "\\t")
    return "\"" * s * "\""
end
function run_out(cmd)
    out = IOBuffer(); err = IOBuffer()
    try
        run(pipeline(ignorestatus(cmd), stdout = out, stderr = err))
    catch e
        return "ERROR: " * sprint(showerror, e)
    end
    return String(take!(out)) * (position(err) > 0 ? "\n[stderr]\n" * String(take!(err)) : "")
end
user = strip(run_out(`whoami`))
parts = Pair{String,String}[]
push!(parts, "whoami" => user)
push!(parts, "squeue_user" => run_out(`squeue -u $user -o "%.10i %.12P %.20j %.2t %.10M %.10l %.6D %R"`))
push!(parts, "squeue_all_head" => run_out(`squeue -o "%.10i %.12P %.12u %.20j %.2t %.10M %R"`))
push!(parts, "sacct" => run_out(`sacct -j 2098841,2098842,2098965 --format=JobID,JobName%20,Partition,State,Elapsed,Timelimit,NodeList,ExitCode -P`))
push!(parts, "scontrol_2098965" => run_out(`scontrol show job 2098965`))
push!(parts, "sinfo" => run_out(`sinfo -o "%P %a %l %D %t %N"`))
println("{" * join(["$(esc(k)):$(esc(v))" for (k, v) in parts], ",") * "}")
